limits: This closes scoped independent GC only, not the whole V1-05 or V1 plan. Custom scripts and natural-exit/process ownership remain open.
cfg=None/scope=None now refuse; external destructive callers must pass their actual complete project configuration/scope. Genuine explicit legacy storage remains supported.
Bounded no-follow metadata, fresh read-only closed authority and shared task guards coordinate framework writers; not an adversarial same-UID sandbox or discovery of undeclared dependencies.
Quarantine can preserve an uncertain detach/reclaim and diagnose it on later runs; no automatic retry/recovery worker, cross-device copy/delete, rollback or power-loss proof.
Dry-run count keys are previews. Logical deleted bytes are not physical blocks; same-filesystem archive moved_bytes does not release that filesystem's space and freed_bytes is zero.
Keep/ranking/GC receipts do not establish scientific validity or observation-backed selection. Old malformed-JSON/ascending ranking control remains unchanged.
No live training, paid provider, GPU, production licensing change, holdout read, release/deployment/main merge, generic CPU autoresearch loop or research efficiency gain.
Exact inventories and actual pytest completion summaries are preserved; no claim that complete progress stdout was archived.
